about: What the public ledger and status pages may show. Only entries with "show": true are served by the stats API or drawn on zipcoin.org; everything else stays off, including its address. Keys are deployment keys (contracts/deployments/<name>.json), plus "safe" (the treasury Safe, read on-chain). To publish a feature at its launch, set "show": true and fill in name, contract, role, controller and powers. See docs/DEPLOY.md, step 8b.

contracts.name: The privacy pool
contracts.role: Holds every zipped ZC and the tree of notes. Coins leave only with a zero-knowledge proof, or by ragequit to the wallet that deposited them.
contracts.controller: No owner. The ZC holder rewards it earns (ETH) go to a treasury address fixed at deployment.
powers: The Entrypoint's owner can wind it down: no new deposits, while withdrawals and ragequits keep working. It can't be undone.
Anyone may call harvest(), which can only send the pool's ETH rewards to that fixed treasury address.

contracts.name: The Entrypoint
contracts.role: The front door: takes deposits, relays withdrawals, and stores the approved-deposit (ASP) roots that private withdrawals must prove against.
contracts.controller: A 2-of-3 Safe holds the owner role. The postman's key can only publish ASP roots.
powers: Owner Safe: upgrade the Entrypoint, register or remove a pool, change a pool's minimum deposit and fee settings, wind a pool down, withdraw Entrypoint fees. An upgrade can change anything the Entrypoint does; ragequit lives in the pool itself, so it can't be taken away by one.
Postman: publish a new ASP root, which decides which deposits may be withdrawn privately. It can't move coins, and a depositor who isn't approved can always ragequit.

contracts.name: ZC
contracts.role: The currency. zipcoin adds no new token.
contracts.controller: Not a zipcoin contract. zipcoin has no power over the token.

contracts.name: Payments
contracts.role: Pays a shop from a zipped note and settles the sales tax in the same proof: part burned, part to the couriers, the rest to the treasury's share.
contracts.controller: No owner. The tax rate, the split and where each part goes were fixed at deployment.

contracts.name: Shops
contracts.role: Shops stake ZC to be listed and sign every invoice. A shop caught asking to be paid around the tax loses its stake: half to whoever caught it, half burned.

contracts.name: Couriers
contracts.role: Couriers bond ZC and publish an address. They carry proofs, hold them for a random while, and are paid the couriers' share of the tax. A courier that breaks a signed promise can be slashed by anyone holding the receipt.

contracts.name: Badges
contracts.role: Lock ZC for a while to earn a tier you can prove without saying who you are. The stake goes back into the pool as a new note when the lock ends.

contracts.name: Anonymous posts
contracts.role: Posts from inside a group ("someone with a tier-3 badge says..."), a few per member per day, with no way to link two of them.
contracts.controller: No owner, and it holds no funds.

contracts.name: Polls
contracts.role: Burn ZC to ask a group a question and pay members to answer. Answers are public and countable; who answered isn't.

contracts.name: Broadcasts
contracts.role: Burn ZC to be heard. The burn is the signal readers rank messages by.

contracts.name: Doorstep
contracts.role: Burn ZC at someone's door, with an optional gift that can never dwarf the burn.

contracts.name: Private sends
contracts.role: Spends a note and deposits the value again for the recipient, so the coins never leave the pool.

contracts.name: Zip addresses
contracts.role: Maps a wallet to a public encryption key, so anyone can send to it privately.
contracts.controller: No owner. Each wallet manages its own entry.

contracts.name: Treasury liquidity bands
contracts.role: Receives the treasury's share of the sales tax and adds it to ZC's pool as fixed one-sided ZC bands above the launch range only (never below it), by fixed rules, when a courier triggers it. Fees, and any ETH it receives, go to the treasury Safe.
contracts.controller: The treasury Safe (2-of-3), within limits fixed at deployment.
powers: Anyone: deposit (within the caps and the minimum interval), collect fees to the Safe, claim the contract's own ETH rewards.

The Safe only: set the caps (never above the ceilings fixed at deployment), band weights and the share of ETH passed straight to the Safe; pause; forward everything to the Safe; withdraw. Every exit pays the Safe and nothing else.

contracts.name: The treasury Safe
contracts.role: The project treasury. It receives the bands' fees and exits and the pool's harvested ETH rewards, and pays the running costs.
contracts.controller: A 2-of-3 Safe: any payment needs two of its three signers.
